result.title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
result.summary: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「农业世界模型」任务：仅凭单张照片、品种与视角，预测同一水稻或玉米在数天至数月后所处的生长阶段与外观；方法 AgroWM 先用 PhenoClock 推断当前与未来生育期并写出含株高、面积、颜色数值目标的 Growth Script，再由 Rooted Renderer 据此编辑原图，并用植株后续照片按性状与发育时序评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“先推断照片只能间接揭示的隐发育状态、再以显式脚本约束后继生成”的结构，以及指出像素指标偏好不变副本、改用阶段与性状匹配的评估思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中隐状态承载任务必要信息、以及 latent 内容是否真被答案使用的检验线索；但推理为文本数值而非 latent，跨模态长时预测与 VLM 推理距离较远，需进一步判断可迁移性。
